title: Per-catalog themes and launch options

cards.title: Upcoming Supporter Features
cards.body:
*A quick note about where Shift is headed*

Honestly, Shift already does more than I imagined when I first started building it for myself. At this point *it covers everything I personally need from a launcher*, and then some.

That said, I'd still like to keep adding features and fixing things as they come up, and that takes real time to keep up with. So an upcoming update will introduce Supporter Features: a one-time unlock for a set of non-essential extras.

To be clear about what this means: the core Shift experience, everything that makes it work as your launcher, will always stay free. What becomes part of Supporter Features is stuff on top of that: extra themes and visual customization, and a handful of other non-essential extras, including a few things that are currently existing today.

*This isn't landing right away*, it's still being worked on, and I'll share more details once it's closer to ready.

*Thanks for sticking with Shift*. Feedback and feature requests still matter more than anything else.

cards.title: Per-catalog themes
cards.body:
Each store catalog (Xbox, Steam, Epic, GOG) is a different list of games, and a layout that suits one often doesn't suit another.

Turn on *Per-Catalog themes* in *Settings > Visuals > Theme* to give each catalog its own theme and theme settings, separate from the main grid.

Off by default, and a catalog follows the main grid until you change something inside it.

cards.title: Launch options
cards.body:
Set per-game command-line arguments right from a game's own menu.

Open *Game Menu > Tools*, then pick from quick preset chips for common flags or type your own.

Supported on Steam, GOG, Xbox, and custom apps.

changelog: New: *Per-catalog theme + settings*, check out Settings > Visuals > Theme, off by default.
New: *Launch options*. Per-game command-line args from Game Menu > Tools.
Shelf theme: store-logo shimmer while loading, and a title placeholder for games with no artwork at all.
Fixed a second controller occasionally going dead right after Shift refocuses.
Fixed a catalog's background sometimes staying on screen after leaving it.
Fixed Epic forcing re-sign-in when just offline/slow, plus other slow-connection fixes.
Fixed REFramework detection (Onimusha WotS etc.) and its _storage_ shadow folder.
Welcome Tour: highlights are now more reliable when flipping cards quickly.
Several other bug fixes, and UI polish.

fr.*A quick note about where Shift is heade:
*Un petit mot sur la suite de Shift*

Honnêtement, Shift fait déjà plus que ce que j’imaginais quand je l’ai commencé pour moi. Aujourd’hui, *il fait tout ce dont j’ai besoin dans un launcher*, et même plus.

Cela dit, j’ai envie de continuer à ajouter des fonctions et à corriger les soucis au fil de l’eau, et ça prend vraiment du temps. Une prochaine mise à jour va donc introduire les fonctions Supporter : un déblocage unique pour une série de bonus non essentiels.

Pour être clair : le cœur de Shift, tout ce qui en fait ton launcher, restera toujours gratuit. Les fonctions Supporter viennent en plus : des thèmes en plus, de la personnalisation visuelle et quelques autres bonus non essentiels, dont certains trucs qui existent déjà aujourd’hui.

*Ce n’est pas pour tout de suite*, c’est encore en chantier, et je donnerai plus de détails quand ce sera presque prêt.

*Merci de rester avec Shift*. Tes avis et tes idées de fonctions comptent toujours plus que tout.

id.Per-catalog themes and launch options: Tema per katalog dan opsi launch
id.*A quick note about where Shift is heade:
*Sedikit cerita soal arah Shift ke depan*

Jujur, Shift sekarang sudah bisa lebih dari yang aku bayangin waktu pertama bikin buat diri sendiri. Saat ini *Shift sudah mencakup semua yang aku butuhkan dari sebuah launcher*, bahkan lebih.

Tapi aku masih pengin terus nambah fitur dan benerin masalah yang muncul, dan itu makan waktu yang nggak sedikit. Jadi update yang akan datang bakal ngenalin Fitur Supporter: sekali bayar untuk buka sekumpulan tambahan yang nggak esensial.

Biar jelas: inti Shift, semua yang bikin Shift jalan sebagai launcher kamu, bakal selalu gratis. Yang masuk Fitur Supporter adalah tambahan di atasnya: tema ekstra dan kustomisasi tampilan, plus beberapa tambahan lain yang nggak esensial, termasuk beberapa hal yang sudah ada sekarang.

*Ini belum langsung datang*, masih dikerjain, dan aku bakal kasih detailnya kalau sudah hampir siap.

*Makasih sudah setia sama Shift*. Feedback dan request fitur tetap yang paling penting.
id.Each store catalog (Xbox, Steam, Epic, G:
Tiap katalog store (Xbox, Steam, Epic, GOG) isinya beda-beda, dan layout yang cocok buat satu sering nggak cocok buat yang lain.

Nyalain *Tema per katalog* di *Pengaturan > Tampilan > Tema* biar tiap katalog punya tema dan pengaturan sendiri, terpisah dari grid utama.

Off secara default, dan katalog ikut grid utama sampai kamu ubah sesuatu di dalamnya.
id.Set per-game command-line arguments righ:
Atur argumen command-line per game langsung dari menu game-nya.

Buka *Menu Game > Tools*, lalu pilih preset cepat buat flag yang umum atau ketik sendiri.

Bisa untuk Steam, GOG, Xbox, dan app custom.
